title: roadmap_claim: a device-only Next ask read as free, and a Next number used twice was claimed silently
problem: payapps #11's only open ask without a demand gate was 'check it on a Windows PC and an Android phone with a real iPhone photo'. No gate phrase matched it, so --bets listed it as the one free item of bet #1 and named it 'Start here'; cloud sessions have headless Chromium on Linux, not those devices, and fell back to reading ROADMAPs by hand. Separately, jobshop-quote's Next numbered two items 15, and --claim 15 silently claimed the second (dict(items)).
